main_subject.detail: A technical beauty poster with a Cocoon sunscreen bottle tipped upside down, dispensing a beige cream ribbon beside giant 'ZnO' typography and microscope comparison images contrasting new-generation and old-generation ZnO particles.
main_subject.style: Scientific beauty campaign poster, premium formula-tech visual, pastel lab-aesthetic composite

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'MÀNG LỌC VÔ CƠ ZnO THẾ HỆ MỚI', bullet points 'KÍCH THƯỚC NON-NANO' and 'HẠT ĐỒNG ĐỀU, BỀ MẶT XỬ LÍ TỐT', title 'KĨ THUẬT BÀO CHẾ HIỆN ĐẠI', and microscope labels 'ZnO THẾ HỆ MỚI' and 'ZnO THẾ HỆ CŨ HÌNH DẠNG KHÔNG ĐỒNG ĐỀU'.
items: Top Left: Upside-down sunscreen bottle occupying the left half, with visible SPF 50+ label and tone-up beige badge.
Top Right: Huge white 'ZnO' typography and the smaller heading 'MÀNG LỌC VÔ CƠ'.
Bottom Left: Beige cream ribbon extruded from the bottle nozzle in a smooth zigzag on a fingertip.
Bottom Right: White-framed panel containing two grayscale microscope images, with the magenta title 'KĨ THUẬT BÀO CHẾ HIỆN ĐẠI'.
Center/Background: Blue-to-pink gradient backdrop with white bullet list text beside the main bottle.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy bottle highlights, creamy texture definition, clean infographic readability, premium tech mood
